entities.summary: Takenoshin Nakai  was a Japanese botanist. In 1919 and 1930, he published papers on the plants of Japan and Korea, including the genus Cephalotaxus. Between 1943 and 1945, during the Japanese occupation of the Dutch East Indies, Takenoshin Nakai was the director of 's Lands Plantentuin in Batavia.
